evaluation_basis: Assessed for implementing the frozen cross-sectional 8h perpetual research design; absent empirical outputs are not inferred.
original_objective: Test funding/premium crowding cross-sectionally on an 8h settlement clock and independently revisit the OI-Bear discovery.

engineering_result.summary: The repository contains the frozen runner and regression tests, including UTC normalization and non-overlapping 24h portfolio evaluation.

scientific_result.summary: No canonical empirical values, workflow run ID or artifact digest are available in the present repository evidence set; no alpha conclusion is assigned.

economic_result.summary: The available record does not support a verified net-performance statement; reported PnL design also excluded perpetual funding cashflows.

limitations: Funding cashflows excluded from reported PnL design
contribution_to_next_version: Established the cross-sectional settlement-clock implementation and exposed the need for a fully reproducible real-data rerun.
